text: ይህ ባሌ ነው / ዪህች ሚስቴ ናት
romanization_bgn: yih balē new / yīhich mīstē nat
ipa: jɨh bale nəw / jihɨtʃ miste nat

text: ዪህች ሴት ልጄ ናት / ይህ ወንድ ልጄ ነው
romanization_bgn: yīhich sēt lijē nat / yih wend lijē new
ipa: jihɨtʃ set lɨdʒe nat / jɨh wənd lɨdʒe nəw
literal: my girl child / my boy child — ልጅ is either
